description:
FILED s470bt (Opus, 2026-09-06) by the B6 IR conformance corpus (4 cases).
#1020 (completed) made `undef *GLOB` empty the four slots' CONTENTS.  The
SLOT INTROSPECTION half is still wrong.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL main cd34df72):

  our @a = (9); our %h = (k=>1);
  undef *a; undef *h;
  print "arr=", (defined *a{ARRAY} ? "present" : "undef"),
        " hsh=", (defined *h{HASH}  ? "present" : "undef"), "\n";

  perl   arr=undef hsh=undef
  PCL    arr=present hsh=present

Same for `undef *_` inside a sub (`*_{ARRAY}` stays defined where perl clears
it -- 078-coercion), and for the `undef *_` + `&utf8::encode` shape
(077-coercion, which reads `*_{ARRAY}` as a VALUE and prints ARRAY(0x1) where
perl prints undef).

CORPUS CASES: 077-coercion 078-coercion 092-hash 094-hash.


=== SIZED WITH #1117 (s473h, Opus, 2026-09-08) ===
This task and #1117 are the same defect seen from two sides.  The three
measurements the fix needs are in #1117's `=== SIZED (s473h) ===` section:
(i) 1 207 package-aggregate cell-expansion sites over 40 emitted perl-tests
files (145 aggregates, ~6 % of emitted lines); (ii) a hand-built
vivify-on-read symbol macro costs 3-5 % on a loop made ENTIRELY of
per-element package-aggregate access, and 0 on the foreach shape (which
expands the cell ONCE, not per element); (iii) the only NON-TEST consumer of
`*a{ARRAY}` / `*a{HASH}` in any of the four populations is Carp.pm, which uses
the slot as a GUARD with a second contents-testing conjunct four times -- so
it survives PCL's always-"present" answer, and that is why nothing has broken.
Corpus rows 077/078/092/094-typeglob stay in known-fail.tsv.
subject: SILENT WRONG (residue of #1020, found by the ir-conform corpus): after `undef *GLOB` the ARRAY/HASH SLOTS still report present -- `*a{ARRAY}` is defined where perl says undef
